hunks.baseline: I couldn’t see it. But I could feel it.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t see it, but I could feel it.

hunks.baseline: Centered around me—or rather, flowing out from the Skeleton Warlord in the subspace known as my Inventory—a sticky energy spread in every direction.
hunks.sol: Centered on me—or rather, flowing from the Skeleton Warlord inside the subspace known as my Inventory—a sticky energy spread in every direction.

hunks.baseline: The change happened in an instant.
hunks.sol: The change was immediate.

hunks.baseline: The movements of the monsters, who had been nothing short of ferocious, abruptly stopped.
hunks.sol: The ferocious monsters abruptly stopped moving.

hunks.baseline: Orcs, Trolls, goblins, Lycanthropes, every kind of monster I had only ever seen in monster encyclopedias, and even the fallen Hunters.
hunks.sol: Orcs, Trolls, goblins, Lycanthropes, every kind of monster I had only ever seen in monster encyclopedias, and even fallen Hunters.

hunks.baseline: I swallowed dryly and muttered.
hunks.sol: I swallowed dryly and muttered, “It works.”

hunks.baseline: “It works.”
My brain froze for a moment before I whispered,
“What kind of dog-bone bullshit is that? Didn’t you try it because you knew it would work?”
hunks.sol: My brain froze for a moment. Then I whispered, “What kind of dog-bone bullshit is that? Didn’t you try it because you knew it would work?”

hunks.baseline: —The truth is… This commander did not know it would work so easily.
hunks.sol: —The truth is… even this commander did not expect it to work so easily.

hunks.baseline: —I was too proud to just sit around doing nothing…
hunks.sol: —My pride would not allow me to sit around doing nothing…

hunks.baseline: *Isn’t this guy completely insane?*
hunks.sol: *Is this guy completely insane?*

hunks.baseline: I was dumbfounded, but regardless of that, the result was undeniable.
hunks.sol: I was dumbfounded, but regardless, the result was undeniable.

hunks.baseline: The undead monsters within a radius of several dozen meters had all stopped moving at once, and the fierce battle raging around us had temporarily fallen into a lull.
hunks.sol: The undead monsters within a radius of several dozen meters had all stopped moving at once, bringing the fierce battle raging around us to a temporary lull.

hunks.baseline: Only some of the nearby undead monsters had come under the Skeleton Warlord’s control. The ones farther away, along with the ordinary monsters that were not undead, were exceptions.
hunks.sol: Only some of the nearby undead monsters had come under the Skeleton Warlord’s control. Those farther away, along with the ordinary monsters that were not undead, were unaffected.

hunks.baseline: The uncontrolled monsters were only briefly bewildered by the sudden change in their own kind before they began rampaging again, and the battle resumed.
hunks.sol: The uncontrolled monsters were briefly bewildered by the sudden change in their own kind, but they soon began rampaging again, and the battle resumed.

hunks.baseline: It was a fight where the two sides could not even be compared in terms of numbers.
hunks.sol: The two sides were hopelessly mismatched in numbers.

hunks.baseline: But from this moment onward, that would change.
hunks.sol: But from this moment onward, that was about to change.

hunks.baseline: I shouted in a hushed voice.
hunks.sol: I called out in a deliberately hushed voice.

hunks.baseline: The Warlordmon—no, the Skeleton Warlord—shouted back in outrage.
hunks.sol: Warlordmon—no, the Skeleton Warlord—shouted back in outrage.

hunks.baseline: “Then how about Warlordmon who’s desperate to be annihilated?”
hunks.sol: “How about Warlordmon Who’s Desperate to Be Erased?”

hunks.baseline: That guy had definitely started enjoying the whole Skeleton Skeleton thing. It was hardly an impressive incantation, but its effect was undeniable.
hunks.sol: That bastard had definitely started enjoying the whole Skeleton Skeleton thing. It was hardly an impressive incantation, but its effect was undeniable.

hunks.baseline: At the Skeleton Warlord’s command, ferocity filled the eyes of the undead monsters that had been standing blankly. Then, in the next moment—
hunks.sol: At the Skeleton Warlord’s command, ferocity returned to the eyes of the undead monsters that had been standing blankly. Then, in the next instant—

hunks.baseline: That was the beginning.
hunks.sol: That was only the beginning.

hunks.baseline: —Ch, chirik?
hunks.sol: —Ch-Chirik?

hunks.baseline: 「W-What the hell!」
hunks.sol: 「W-What the hell?」

hunks.baseline: The Chinese Hunters were also bewildered by the sudden turn of events.
hunks.sol: The Chinese Hunters were just as bewildered by the sudden turn of events.

hunks.baseline: I shouted toward the young Hunter who had been cutting through the battlefield with his spear from the front of the formation.
hunks.sol: I shouted to the young Hunter who had been racing across the front lines, swinging his spear.

hunks.baseline: His round eyes looked toward me.
hunks.sol: His eyes widened as he looked at me.

hunks.baseline: I had just checked his Level with Qi Sense, but that was not important right now.
hunks.sol: I had just used Qi Sense to check his Level window, but that wasn’t important right now.

hunks.baseline: “Are you really curious about that right now? Do you want to grab an undead monster and make it explain why it’s helping us using the five Ws and one H?”
hunks.sol: “Is that really what you’re worried about right now? Do you want to grab an undead monster and make it explain why it’s helping us using the five Ws and one H?”

hunks.baseline: “Then what should you do now?”
hunks.sol: “Then what should you be doing?”

hunks.baseline: Shao Shen’s eyes cleared, and he raised his spear high.
hunks.sol: Shao Shen snapped to his senses and thrust his spear into the air.

hunks.baseline: *That was an excellent decision.*
hunks.sol: *Now that was an excellent decision.*

hunks.baseline: Along with their unified shout, the momentum of the roughly five hundred Hunters who had been driven into a corner changed.
hunks.sol: With that unified shout, the momentum of the roughly five hundred Hunters who had been driven into a corner transformed.

hunks.baseline: A Lycanthrope charged toward a Hunter who had just cut down an Orc.
hunks.sol: A Lycanthrope charged at a Hunter who had just beheaded an Orc.

hunks.baseline: The creature opened its jaws, yellow fangs aimed at the Hunter’s throat, but a massive fist slammed into its mouth.
hunks.sol: Its jaws opened, yellow fangs poised to tear out the Hunter’s throat, but a massive fist slammed into its mouth.

hunks.baseline: Above the ogre’s head, a Griffon dove sharply. Its razor-sharp claws flashed.
hunks.sol: High above the ogre, a Griffon plunged into a steep dive, its razor-sharp claws flashing.

hunks.baseline: The waiting ranged Hunters unleashed their magic, and the electrocuted Griffon shuddered in midair.
hunks.sol: The ranged Hunters waiting nearby unleashed their magic. The electrocuted Griffon convulsed in midair.

hunks.baseline: At that very moment, a figure sprang upward after stepping on a Troll’s shoulder and swung a weapon at the Griffon.
hunks.sol: At that moment, a figure stepped off a Troll’s shoulder, launched himself into the air, and swung his weapon at the Griffon.

hunks.baseline: “Specially made by J Company, widely considered one of Germany’s finest weapon workshops—!”
hunks.sol: “Custom-made by J Company, widely considered one of Germany’s finest weapon manufacturers—!”

hunks.baseline: The clean, effortless strike split the Griffon’s head in two.
hunks.sol: A single clean, effortless strike split the Griffon’s head in two.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi landed gracefully and smiled with satisfaction as he looked at the transparent sword blade, which did not have a single drop of blood on it.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi landed gracefully and gazed at the transparent blade, not a single drop of blood staining it, with a satisfied smile.

hunks.baseline: “A longsword I won at auction for 5.2 billion won. It certainly earns its price.”
hunks.sol: “A longsword I won at auction for 5.2 billion won. It certainly earns its keep.”

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton Warlord, who had been watching the scene, asked in a dubious voice,
hunks.sol: After watching the whole thing, the Skeleton Warlord asked dubiously,

hunks.baseline: —Wicked human, you said that man was your superior?
hunks.sol: —Wicked human, did you say that man was your superior?

hunks.baseline: “No, well. Technically speaking, in terms of Guild positions, he is, but…”
hunks.sol: “No, well… Technically, as far as our Guild positions go, he is, but…”

hunks.baseline: —He looked rather clever for a human, but I have never seen such a strange human. He truly is a fitting superior for you.
hunks.sol: —He seemed reasonably clever for a human, yet I have never encountered anyone so strange. He truly is a fitting superior for you.

hunks.baseline: “Who wants to be annihilated because he couldn’t keep his mouth shut?”
hunks.sol: “Raise your hand if you’re a Skeleton Warlord who wants to be erased for running his mouth.”

hunks.baseline: They say even a dog at a village school can recite poetry after three years. Now he could do it without being told.
hunks.sol: Even a dog could recite poetry after three years at a village school. Now he knew what to do without being told.

hunks.baseline: The Griffon killed by Team Leader Choi, along with the monsters brought down by the combined attacks of the Hunters and undead, gained new life and rose from their dead bodies.
hunks.sol: The Griffon Team Leader Choi had killed, along with the monsters brought down by the combined attacks of the Hunters and undead, gained new life and raised their dead bodies from the ground.

hunks.baseline: It seemed the range was also wider than during the first attempt. Even the undead monsters in the distance had come under the Skeleton Warlord’s control and begun attacking their former allies.
hunks.sol: The range also seemed wider than during the first attempt. Even distant undead monsters came under the Skeleton Warlord’s control and began attacking their former allies.

hunks.baseline: —……Actually, this commander was not capable of quite this much. But for some reason, an enormous amount of mana is surging through me now that I am here!
hunks.sol: —……Actually, this commander was not capable of quite this much. But for some reason, an enormous amount of mana has been surging through me since I arrived here!

hunks.baseline: I gave up on trying to understand this bizarre named monster.
hunks.sol: I gave up trying to understand this bizarre named monster.

hunks.baseline: As long as the result was good, that was all that mattered. Trying to figure it out right now would only give me a headache.
hunks.sol: As long as the result was good, that was all that mattered. Trying to figure it out right away would only give me a headache.

hunks.baseline: —Give me more. More legions!
hunks.sol: —Give me more. Give me an even greater legion!

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t see him because he was inside my Inventory, but I was certain his bony skull was trembling with excitement.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t see him because he was inside my Inventory, but I was certain his fleshless skull was trembling with excitement.

hunks.baseline: I sighed and tightened my grip on the spear.
hunks.sol: I sighed and tightened my grip on my spear.

hunks.baseline: “I was planning to.”
hunks.sol: “I was already planning to.”

hunks.baseline: The bastard was being cheeky, but this time, I had no choice but to agree with part of what he said.
hunks.sol: The bastard was getting cheeky, but this time, I had to agree with at least part of what he said.

hunks.baseline: Listening to the Skeleton Warlord’s laughter echo through my mind, I stepped forward.
hunks.sol: With the Skeleton Warlord’s mad laughter echoing through my mind, I stepped forward.

hunks.baseline: A path of flame opened with every step.
hunks.sol: A path of flame opened beneath my feet.

hunks.baseline: Black robes. A staff with skulls dangling from it.
hunks.sol: Black robes. Staffs hung with dangling skulls.

hunks.baseline: The places where their pupils should have been were empty, and patches of flesh that had yet to rot still clung to their bodies.
hunks.sol: Their eye sockets were empty, and patches of unrotted flesh still clung to their bodies.

hunks.baseline: The three beings, who looked as though they had stepped out of a nightmare, conveyed their thoughts to one another.
hunks.sol: The three beings, each looking as though it had stepped straight out of a nightmare, sent their thoughts to one another.

hunks.baseline: All monsters had a hierarchy, but undead were ruled by power more absolutely than any other species.
hunks.sol: All monsters had a hierarchy, but the undead were ruled by strength more absolutely than any other kind.

hunks.baseline: If control had been stolen from them like this, it was undoubtedly the work of a higher existence.
hunks.sol: If their control had been stolen, it could only be the work of a higher existence.

hunks.baseline: How could an existence more powerful than them be here, seize control of the undead, and help the humans?
hunks.sol: How could an existence more powerful than them be here, seizing control of the undead and helping the humans?

hunks.baseline: —That is absurd. Have you forgotten the command that person gave us when sending us here?
hunks.sol: —Absurd. Have you forgotten the command that person gave us when sending us here?

hunks.baseline: —Kill the humans. Create more undead and an army, and kill more, more humans.
hunks.sol: —Kill the humans. Create more undead and a greater legion, then kill more. More humans.

hunks.baseline: The three beings recalled the command and fell into a state of confusion.
hunks.sol: Recalling their command, the three beings fell into confusion.

hunks.baseline: If that person—the Arch Lich—was not responsible, then who could possibly surpass their control?
hunks.sol: If that person—the Arch Lich—was not responsible, then who could possibly possess greater control than they did?

hunks.baseline: —Humans reject and despise death. That is impossible. Even if there were one, they would be nothing compared to us.
hunks.sol: —Humans reject and despise death. That cannot be. Even if one were among them, they would be nothing compared to us.

hunks.baseline: The reason unmistakable hostility could be felt in their thoughts was that they, too, had once been necromancers who had suffered human rejection and contempt.
hunks.sol: Unmistakable hostility permeated their thoughts because they, too, had once been necromancers who suffered humanity’s rejection and contempt.

hunks.baseline: Drifting across the boundless ocean of death, they had met a boatman named the Arch Lich. After gaining new power, they were finally on the verge of becoming the Liches they had longed to be.
hunks.sol: While drifting across the boundless ocean of death, they had met a boatman named the Arch Lich. He had granted them new power, placing them on the verge of becoming the Liches they had longed to be.

hunks.baseline: —Then we would not have lost control, either.
hunks.sol: —Then we would not have lost control.

hunks.baseline: They had been great necromancers while alive, but they had not yet fully transformed into Liches.
hunks.sol: They had been great necromancers while alive, but they had yet to complete their transformation into Liches.

hunks.baseline: They had been reborn using the bodies of dead mages, but one week was far too short to absorb enough death energy to complete their transformation into Liches.
hunks.sol: They had been reborn in the bodies of dead mages, but one week was far too short to absorb enough death energy to become full-fledged Liches.

hunks.baseline: —That is why that person sent the three of us.
hunks.sol: —That is why that person sent all three of us.

hunks.baseline: They had to overcome this crisis somehow if they wanted to earn the Arch Lich’s favor.
hunks.sol: If they wanted to earn the Arch Lich’s favor, they had to overcome this crisis somehow.

hunks.baseline: Even if it meant exhausting a tremendous amount of power.
hunks.sol: Even if it meant expending a tremendous amount of power.

hunks.baseline: —Are you suggesting that we combine our strength?
hunks.sol: —Are you suggesting we combine our strength?

hunks.baseline: The three beings, who had been competing to earn the Arch Lich’s favor, finally reached an agreement.
hunks.sol: The three beings, who had been competing for the Arch Lich’s favor, finally reached an agreement.

hunks.baseline: Without hesitation, they began chanting a spell of necromancy.
hunks.sol: Without hesitation, they began chanting necromantic spells.

hunks.baseline: The green grass turned black, and the soldiers of the People’s Liberation Army within its range clutched their throats and collapsed.
hunks.sol: The green grass turned black, and the soldiers of the People’s Liberation Army within range clutched their throats and collapsed.

hunks.baseline: The death energy flowing from the bodies of the humans whose lives had been cut short seeped into the monsters’ entire bodies.
hunks.sol: As the humans breathed their last, death energy flowed from their bodies and seeped into every part of the monsters.

hunks.baseline: The air trembled from the powerful mana carried in their savage cries. Their strength was beyond comparison with that of ordinary monsters.
hunks.sol: The air trembled with the powerful mana carried in their savage cries. Their strength was beyond comparison with that of ordinary monsters.

hunks.baseline: Only after sensing their strengthened control and the power of the monsters under their command did the three beings stop chanting.
hunks.sol: Only after sensing their strengthened control and the greater power of the monsters under their command did the three beings stop chanting.

hunks.baseline: —We did consume an enormous amount of power… but this is more than enough.
hunks.sol: —We consumed an enormous amount of power… but this is more than enough.

hunks.baseline: Just as the three beings were smiling in satisfaction at their now more powerful army—
hunks.sol: Just as the three beings smiled in satisfaction at their newly empowered legion—

hunks.baseline: Far away, a monster’s limbs flew through the air with a thunderous explosion.
hunks.sol: Far away, a monster’s limbs flew through the air amid a thunderous explosion.

hunks.baseline: The three beings looked toward the rising flames and exchanged thoughts.
hunks.sol: The three beings watched the flames rise and exchanged thoughts.

hunks.baseline: —He is still only human. Deploy a large number of Skeleton Mages.
hunks.sol: —He is still only human. Deploy the Skeleton Mages in force.

hunks.baseline: A short while later, more flames rose into the distance, and the three beings looked at one another.
hunks.sol: A short while later, flames erupted again, and the three beings looked at one another.

hunks.baseline: —Did he annihilate them? Impressive.
hunks.sol: —He erased them? Impressive.

hunks.baseline: —But is he really a mage? His movements seem far too fast…
hunks.sol: —But is he truly a mage? His movements seem far too fast…

hunks.baseline: —I’ll see your ogres and raise you Dullahans.
hunks.sol: —I will see your ogres and add Dullahans.

hunks.baseline: —He is right. Dullahans would be excessive. Strengthened ogres will be enough.
hunks.sol: —He is right. Dullahans would be excessive. The strengthened ogres will be enough.

hunks.baseline: Three minutes later, a grim atmosphere hung over the three beings’ skulls.
hunks.sol: Three minutes later, the air above the three beings’ skulls had turned grim.

hunks.baseline: —It broke.
hunks.sol: —It was severed.

hunks.baseline: —I told you we should send Dullahans.
hunks.sol: —I told you we should send the Dullahans.

hunks.baseline: —J-Just send the Dullahans first!
hunks.sol: —J-Just send the Dullahans already!

hunks.baseline: The three beings watched as more than twenty Dullahans, chosen as their escort force, rushed away. Then they quietly began searching for another point of agreement.
hunks.sol: The three beings watched as the more than twenty Dullahans assigned as their escort force rushed away. Then they quietly began searching for another point of agreement.

hunks.baseline: —In an emergency, we can choose the most useful one and make it. If the three of us combine our strength, it will be possible.
hunks.sol: —Given the urgency, we can simply choose the most useful one available. If the three of us combine our strength, it will be possible.

hunks.baseline: But the three beings’ plan to create a Death Knight was smashed to pieces less than ten minutes later.
hunks.sol: But the three beings’ plan to create a Death Knight was shattered less than ten minutes later.

hunks.baseline: Even with nothing but bones left on their bodies, they could feel the heat of the searing flames.
hunks.sol: Even with bodies reduced to little more than bone, they could feel the searing heat.

hunks.baseline: The three beings witnessed an existence tearing through the monster army with a spear engulfed in hellfire and hurriedly began chanting spells.
hunks.sol: The three beings watched a figure tear through the monster army with a spear engulfed in hellfire and hurriedly began chanting spells.

hunks.baseline: Their slow, dragging voices had become as fast as rap.
hunks.sol: Their once slow, dragging voices became as fast as rap.

hunks.baseline: But before the chant was complete, the young human who could not be identified as either a flame mage or a warrior had already arrived right in front of them.
hunks.sol: But before they could complete their spells, the young human—impossible to identify as either a flame mage or a warrior—had already arrived right in front of them.

hunks.baseline: —Y-Yes, Yenwigajike!
hunks.sol: —Y-Yenwigajike!

hunks.baseline: The young man, Jin Taekyung, tilted his head to one side.
hunks.sol: The young man, Jin Taekyung, cocked his head.
